notes: Covering task for C-ce46ee62 (reverse a single-key byte transform to recover the valid WAL). Medium: agent must recover the XOR key from the WAL magic (both checksum-endian variants allowed), invert the transform over the whole file, and replay never-checkpointed rows from the restored WAL via SQLite. Dependent stages (decode then extract), mild reasoning (unique-key argument over 256 candidates), adversarial awareness (SQLite may checkpoint/delete the -wal if opened in place; the tool must operate on copies), quantitative correctness (byte-exact WAL, exact JSON rows). Hidden cases use different keys, lengths and row sets; a hard-coded tool fails. No resource pressure or statefulness.
